map.所需推力和可用推力什么关系？: What is the relation between required and available thrust?
map.平飞/稳速时两者相等；加速或爬升需可用>所需（盈余用于加速/爬升）；所需>可用则: In level or steady flight the two are equal; accelerating or climbing needs available greater than required, with the margin going into acceleration or climb; if required exceeds available the aircraft slows and loses altitude. The performance envelope is the range over which available thrust covers required thrust.
map.高度对所需推力的影响？: How does altitude affect required thrust?
map.密度随高度下降，同等真速下阻力减小，但真速巡航时维持动压需更高速，综合看巡航推力: Density falls with altitude so drag drops at the same true speed, but true-speed cruise needs a higher speed to hold dynamic pressure. Overall cruise thrust falls with altitude before engine thrust decay dominates. The performance manual by altitude is the most accurate source.
